newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse says suspends Eravis.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse says suspends Eravis.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) said on Wednesday it suspended trading in shares of hotel firm Eravis Rt for the rest of the day after a 34 percent rise.
"There won't be any more trading in it today," a BSE official told Reuters.
The suspension came at 1043 GMT, when Eravis shares traded at a new 1997 high of 6,500 forints, up 1,650 forints from Tuesday's close of 4,850.
The bourse suspends trading in any share if it moves more than 20 percent in either direction compared to its previous closing price.
It also suspends trading when any share moves more than 20 percent compared to its opening price if the stock was not traded for at least five successive sessions.
